notes: Young (left, ~x 800-818) and Highland (right) run N-S; Dorchester Av. (top), CARMALT, CHANNING and RINGGOLD run across. Names printed bare: YOUNG, CARMALT, CHANNING, RINGGOLD, ALVIN; DORCHESTER AV., HIGHLAND AV. (on the N-S part), ELIJAH ALLEY as printed. Highland: the street coming down from the north (sheet 174, HIGHLAND AV.) crosses Dorchester at (3022,604) and continues SE as a 50 ft diagonal (174 prints it HIGHLAND ST.) to a bend at about (3435,1200), then runs N-S (centre x 3478 at Carmalt, 3500 at Ringgold) as HIGHLAND AV.; recorded as Highland Avenue throughout. Carmalt, Channing and Ringgold all end at Highland (sheet 166 shows no continuation east). Carmalt's west leg (from 164) meets Young ~30 ft south of the main Carmalt, so two T points. Elijah Alley (16 ft, N-S at x~3058-3072) runs Channing to Ringgold and on south. An unnamed 20 ft alley (block 3, printed 20' near Elijah) runs E-W at y~3560 from Elijah Alley west to the God's Bible School dormitory (x~1805), where it stops; listed under alleys. God's Bible School & Missionary Training Home occupies the block Young / Channing / Ringgold west of x~1800. Alvin's faces are x 2009-2184 (no width printed here).
